오픈소스 라이선스

Solar Work 0.1.0-rc.56 기준

Solar Work 데스크톱 앱, CLI, 웹 화면에는 아래 오픈소스 소프트웨어가 포함되어 있습니다. 각 소프트웨어의 저작권은 해당 저작권자에게 있으며, 각 라이선스 조건에 따라 사용합니다.

앱 서버 · CLI 451

데스크톱 앱에 포함된 서버와 CLI 프로그램에 함께 빌드된 Rust 라이브러리입니다.

shadcn/ui primitives in ../ui (card, badge, collapsible, tooltip, scroll-area, popover, command,
dialog, progress) were copied from the
same commit (packages/shadcn-ui/components/ui); shadcn/ui is MIT-licensed
(https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui, Copyright (c) 2023 shadcn).

Modifications: import paths rewritten from @repo/shadcn-ui/* to @/*; shimmer uses a CSS
keyframe animation instead of motion/react.
tool.tsx: `ai` ToolUIPart replaced by the local ToolState (@/lib/ai-types), CodeBlock
(shiki) replaced by <pre>, ToolHeader takes a ReactNode title, labels in Korean,
tw-animate-css classes dropped, no status badge on successful (output-available) rows.
artifact.tsx, file-tree.tsx, code-block.tsx: "use client" dropped; bordered roots carry a
data-slot so the scoped border-color base rule applies. artifact.tsx uses the existing
../ui/button (sm/ghost variants) and a native title instead of the Radix tooltip.
code-block.tsx keeps only the container/header/title/filename/actions parts — the shiki
highlighter, copy button and language selector are omitted (highlighting stays on
lowlight, rendered as React nodes).
prompt-input.tsx: display parts only (container, header, textarea, footer, tools, button, submit) —
form submit, attachment state, nanoid/FileUIPart and ActionMenu/Select/HoverCard/Tabs/Command parts
dropped; InputGroup replaced by a plain container.
attachments.tsx: inline variant only, local AttachmentData (name + media type) instead of `ai`
FileUIPart, no image/video preview or hover card, remove button always visible (touch).
model-selector.tsx: Popover instead of Dialog; ModelSelectorLogo (models.dev images), Dialog,
Shortcut and Separator dropped.
context.tsx: tokenlens cost lines dropped, Popover instead of HoverCard, usage injected from the
session usage API. ui/popover.tsx stops Escape propagation and
uses a CSS fade instead of tw-animate-css classes.
